scope: Local diagnostic process-isolation experiment; production runtime and deployed architecture unchanged
cloud_constraint: One Cloud Run service, one container, same image; experimental API/engine subprocesses only

workload.features: three levels, fees/NATR, volatility defense, bootstrap/quote guards, drawdown, outflow, inventory skew, operations reads

limitations: One matched pair per CPU setting; not randomized or repeated statistical comparisons
90s and 180s tests have no separate 300s warmup; they cannot replace mixed/hour gates
No per-request server/SQL/GC traces; original historical p99 trigger remains unassigned
Process isolation leaves PostgreSQL aggregates and the shared container CPU quota unchanged
Memory is cgroup memory.peak, a conservative whole-container upper bound including non-RSS pages
Prototype has fixed 8080 ingress/8081 engine ports and test-only pool partitioning; not a production entrypoint
Prototype stops the entire container on either child death; a production API restart policy remains undecided

native_tests.scope: diagnostic failure exit code, bounded DB admission/cancellation/context and deterministic control priority; Cloud Run packaging

test_assumption_fix: Control priority is dispatch order, not completion order across independently scheduled threads. Priority test now frees exactly one worker; no executor/runtime behavior changed.
initial_setup_failures: Existing harness rejected the custom PID1 command before load; corrected by explicitly selecting its test-wrapper entrypoint.
Second preparation duplicated the /test-assets mount; removed the duplicate before load. Both failed setups cleaned their disposable containers.
exploratory_exit_policy: Initial ad hoc scripts returned completion status rather than latency success. Their recorded budget violations remain failures; the promoted runner returns nonzero on healthy violations and has a native regression check.
